title: Suspicious Rundll32 Execution from Temp Folder
id: 2b56d783-6e0a-417e-b09d-238af6c6b030
description: Detects suspicious rundll32.exe executions from temporary directories, which is a common technique used by malware and attackers to load malicious DLLs.
status: experimental
date: 2026/04/09
author: SOC Automated Detection
references:
    - Internal Case INC-AP10-V4
    - https://thedfirreport.com/2021/03/29/suspected-evasive-panda-compromises-u-s-organization/
logic:
    selection:
        img:
            - '*-\rundll32.exe'
        orig_c:
            - '*-\Windows\System32\rundll32.exe'
        temp_path:
            - '*-\AppData\Local\Temp\*'
            - '*-\Temp\*'
            - '*-\Windows\Temp\*'
            - '*-\Users\*\AppData\Local\Temp\*'
    condition: selection and not orig_c and temp_path
falsepositives:
    - Unknown
level: high
